data.title: Oversized Tee — Off-white
data.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

$media.alt: Simple white t-shirt on a light background

data.summary: Roomy through the body, cropped at the hem.

children.text: An oversized cut with a wider neck, dropped shoulders and a slightly cropped length. Size down for a relaxed fit, keep your size for a full oversized look.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
